evidence.description: The log message is executed outside the queue.async barrier block.
The log message is executed outside the queue.async barrier block.

candidates.explanation: The logging statements in the registration and unregistration methods occur outside the barrier block. This can lead to race conditions or inconsistent log ordering where the log message might appear before the actual state change is committed to the set.
candidates.title: Race Condition in Logging

evidence.description: Use of [weak self] in a singleton's registration method.
Use of [weak self] in a singleton's unregistration method.
Use of [weak self] in a singleton's clearAllWindows method.

candidates.explanation: The use of [weak self] inside a queue.async block for a singleton instance is unnecessary and potentially problematic. Since the registry is a singleton (shared instance), it will never be deallocated, and using weak self adds overhead without benefit.
candidates.title: Unnecessary Weak Reference in Singleton
